payload.claim: `export_patch`'s docstring explains why the fresh bare dir is immune to attribute-based binary spoofing purely in terms of the dir having 'no info of its own' (item 103's two vectors), but the diff adds a third vector, a global `attr.tree`, that reaches the fresh dir precisely because it is global config rather than repo-local `info` state, and is neutralized only by the new `-c attr.tree=` pin in `git_argv`, not by the fresh-dir design this docstring credits. The docstring was not updated, so a future reader could remove the `-c` pins believing the fresh-dir construction alone is sufficient.
